'''Tevrin Dol''' was a junior executive serving [[Radell Mining Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] were hired to transport him to [[Torina]] via [[Coyn]].
